很多人问我，为什么按小腿能管脖子、管腰、管肩膀？明明不舒服的地方在上半身，跟小腿有什么关系？恩师这套方法的核心叫小腿全息对应。他在剑桥大学讲过这个原理，几十年的临床经验总结出来的，不是瞎编的。你小腿内侧有一条线，从脚踝到膝盖，对应你整条脊椎。脚踝附近是颈椎区，往上胸椎、腰椎，最上面骶尾区。哪段有硬疙瘩，对应的地方就不舒服。操作就四步：找到堵点、打开气道口、点按堵点、反复做。你试试脚踝上面那一小段，按一按脖子是不是松了？这就是反射区。13节课把每个区域教透，你学会以后，身体哪里不舒服，你心里就有数了。

The scene has a futuristic technological feel: blue and cyan particles form continuous, luminous "sound wave/echo trajectory curves" (particle brightness and density pulsate in a periodic pattern), the sound wave shapes constantly rebound, oscillate, and pulse "jumping but not forming" (the trajectory always remains in the form of an echo curve, and do not suddenly distort into other patterns). The colored light/ scattered light beams/ energy ripples beside keep jumping throughout the entire duration: slight oscillation, flickering, diffusion and re-convergence, while maintaining synchronization with the rhythm of the sound wave trajectory. The background particles and dust float slightly; the luminous edges are clear, allowing for slight trailing but not blurring into a blurry picture. Overall atmosphere: neon sci-fi, dynamic energy field, rich particle details. Camera: slight push-in/ slight lateral parallax (optional), do not shake violently. Target: continuous jumping of the sound wave trajectory + continuous jumping of the light and shadow beside + coherent movement, unified rhythm, without composition collapse.
